Class CachedModelDependencyContainer<TModel>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Allocation
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A osu.Framework.Allocation.DependencyContainer which caches a TModel and members it contains attached with a osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedAttribute as dependencies.

public class CachedModelDependencyContainer<TModel> : IReadOnlyDependencyContainer where TModel : class?, IDependencyInjectionCandidate?, new()

Type Parameters

TModel

The type of the model to cache. Must contain only osu.Framework.Bindables.Bindable`1 fields or auto-properties.

Remarks

Users can query the model by directly querying for the TModel type, and query for the model's dependencies by providing the TModel type as a parent.

Remarks

This model is not injected directly, users of the osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedModelDependencyContainer`1 receive a shadow-bound copy of this value in all cases.
